entries.subject: The colour of the photosphere
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at the published 4,300 K (Donati et al. 2012), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer into sRGB with the D65 white. Gaia DR3 has no BP/RP spectrum that describes this star alone, and no limb-darkening measurement or model grid in the repository reaches it, so the disc is uniform.
entries.revisitWhen: Gaia publishes a spectrum of this star alone, or a limb-darkening law is measured for it.

entries.subject: GQ Lup A's own disc
entries.finding: The star's compact dust disc is imaged by ALMA (MacGregor et al. 2017; Wu et al. 2017) and a spiral arm in scattered light (Stolker et al. 2021), but no package of it is built here.
entries.revisitWhen: A disc package is scoped for this system.
